reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a comprehensive materials list instead of a single cost chip. This means you can see exactly what resources are required for each tile, with shortages highlighted for easy management. For more details, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

posts: Exciting news for Provincia players! We've revamped the build tile system to show a detailed materials list instead of a single cost badge. Now you can easily see what resources you have and what you need. Learn more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

Attention Provincia fans! Our latest update replaces the cost badges with a materials overview for every build tile. This allows for better planning and resource management. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=discord&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

embed.title: New Materials Overview for Build Tiles
embed.description: Say goodbye to confusing cost badges! Our new materials sheet provides a clear view of what's needed for your buildings. Perfect for effective resource management!

steam.title: Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a new feature in Provincia that enhances your building experience! Build tiles now show a detailed materials list rather than a single cost chip, allowing you to easily track your resources and identify shortages. This change is designed to improve your gameplay by providing clearer information at a glance. For more information, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
